quote: In 2024, malaria caused an estimated 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths worldwide. ... The infection is most prevalent in Africa, where 95% of malaria deaths occur ... with children under five accounting for approximately 75% of malaria deaths in that region.
note: Death toll on page is for malaria overall, not P. falciparum alone

claim: Cherrapunji, India, received the most rainfall in one year: 26,470 mm (1,042 inches) from 1860 to 1861.
quote: Most in one year: 26,470 mm (1,042 in); ... Cherrapunji, Meghalaya, India, 1860–1861.

claim: Zeolites are microporous materials with pore sizes of 0.3-2 nm—used to separate molecules by size, crack petroleum, and remove radioactive cesium from water.
corrected_claim: Zeolites are microporous minerals with pores typically 0.3–0.8 nm across that sort molecules by size, serve as catalysts in fluid catalytic cracking of petroleum, and were used after Fukushima to adsorb radioactive cesium-137 from seawater.
quote: Zeolites have microporous structures with a typical diameter of 0.3–0.8 nm. ... are widely used as catalysts in the petrochemical industry, such as in fluid catalytic cracking ... to adsorb the radioactive cesium-137 that was present in high levels.
note: Page gives 0.3-0.8 nm, not 0.3-2 nm.

claim: The four-color theorem (1976) was the first major theorem proven with computer assistance — mathematicians initially rejected it because humans couldn't verify the proof by hand.
corrected_claim: The four color theorem, proved by Appel and Haken in 1976, was the first major theorem proved using a computer — and initially not all mathematicians accepted it, because the proof was infeasible for a human to check by hand.
quote: It was the first major theorem to be proved by use of a computer. ... Initially, this proof was not accepted by all mathematicians ... the computer-assisted proof was infeasible for a human to check by hand.
note: Not 'rejected by mathematicians' generally — 'not accepted by all'

claim: Trypanosoma brucei causes sleeping sickness by crossing the blood-brain barrier — fatal if untreated.
quote: T. brucei is one of only a few pathogens known to cross the blood-brain barrier. ... is roughly 100% fatal when left untreated

claim: Quillagua, Chile, is the driest place on Earth, receiving less than 0.2 mm of rainfall per year—less than an eyelash width.
corrected_claim: Quillagua, in Chile's Antofagasta Region, holds the record for the least rainfall of any locale: 0.2 mm per year or less.
quote: Least per year (locale): 0.2 millimetres (0.008 in) per year or less, ... Quillagua, Antofagasta Region, Chile.
note: Page says 0.2 mm or less; the eyelash comparison is not on the page.

claim: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) have the highest surface areas of any materials—up to 7,000 m²/g—enabling exceptional gas storage and catalysis.
corrected_claim: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) are porous materials whose high surface area and tunable pores make them of interest for storing gases such as hydrogen and carbon dioxide and as potential catalysts.
quote: Because of this property, MOFs are of interest for the storage of gases such as hydrogen and carbon dioxide. ... Their high surface area, tunable porosity, diversity in metal and functional groups make them especially attractive for use as catalysts.
note: Page gives no 7,000 m²/g figure or 'highest of any material' claim.

claim: Automated theorem provers have since proven or verified many important results — the Kepler conjecture about sphere packing was verified by computer in 2017.
corrected_claim: Fully automatic theorem provers have proved a number of hard theorems, including the Robbins conjecture, which had eluded human mathematicians for a long time.
quote: have proved a number of interesting and hard theorems
note: Kepler conjecture / 2017 not mentioned on page

claim: Trypanosoma cruzi (Chagas disease) infects 6-7 million people in Latin America — often for life.
corrected_claim: About 6.5 million people, mostly in Mexico, Central America and South America, have Chagas disease, and unless treated they remain infected with T. cruzi after the acute phase.
quote: It is estimated that 6.5 million people, mostly in Mexico, Central America and South America, have Chagas disease as of 2019 ... Unless treated with antiparasitic drugs, individuals remain infected with T. cruzi after recovering from the acute phase.
note: 'For life' omits the 'unless treated' caveat

claim: Oahu, Hawaii, experienced 331 consecutive days with measurable rainfall in 1939-1940, the world record for continuous rain.
quote: Most consecutive days with measurable rain a day with at least 0.01 inches (0.25 mm) of rainfall: 331 days in ... Oahu, Hawaii, 1939–1940.

claim: Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) are crystalline porous materials made entirely of light elements (C, H, N, O, B) linked by strong covalent bonds.
corrected_claim: Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) are porous, crystalline materials whose building blocks are joined by strong covalent bonds; the first COFs were held together by bonds between boron, carbon and oxygen atoms.
quote: resulting in strong, covalent bonds to afford porous, stable, and crystalline materials ... strong bonds between B, C, and O atoms
note: Page does not define COFs as made entirely of light elements C, H, N, O, B
